title: As at 31 December 2014, the Company had drawn down Ushs 114,388 million (US$ 41,177million) (2013: Ushs

In 2009, the Company signed a borrowing agreement with IfC worth US$ 25 million. The loan attracted interest
of 6 months LIBoR + 5% interest. The entire loan amount of US$ 25 million was fully drawn down in 2011. The
loan was repayable in twenty semi-annual instalments of US$ 1.25 million commencing on 28 february 2011. The
loan was secured by registered debenture and a share pledge agreement. The loan was fully paid in 2013 using
proceeds from facility B.
